project.name: Pytyliki
project.value_proposition: A local engineering workstation for read-only processor discovery, bounded measurements, source diagnostics, memory and DSP tasks.
primary_users: Hardware labs needing repeatable local measurements
jobs_to_be_done: Inspect processor topology and operating-system-ready ISA capabilities
Run bounded local workloads and compare evidence without hardware writes
Review supported source files and process local DSP test vectors

distribution: CMake source build for Windows and Linux command-line use
Windows desktop build workflow and release archive
commercial_position.support_route: Community issue reporting through the repository's GitHub Issues; no response-time commitment or paid support SLA is offered.
commercial_position.privacy_posture: Local-first engineering utility; report export, sharing and telemetry are separately consent-gated. No remote service is required for core workflows.

quality.requirement: Validate dimensions, resource limits and supported inputs before processing.
Keep benchmark results bounded, hardware-dependent and paired with integrity evidence.
Inspect source text without compiling, executing or rewriting the inspected program.
Protect the versioned public C ABI with explicit contract and regression coverage.
Build and test the portable core and separately verify the Windows workstation workflow.

cohesion.requirement: Keep portable C11 operations independent from Windows presentation and platform adapters.
Expose cross-project numerical operations only through the documented Pytyliki C ABI v1.
Record metric, unit, context, source digest and sampling window for comparable measurements.
Describe peer integrations through versioned contracts and explicit native-library trust.
Keep the processor-workstation purpose and safety limits consistent across architecture and product docs.

commercial.requirement: State the intended engineering audience and measurable user jobs without claiming market validation.
Publish local build, test and first-run commands for the supported platforms.
Ship the license text with the source distribution.
Define source distribution and Windows desktop archive workflow.
Collect real user research and adoption evidence before making market-fit or revenue claims.
commercial.reason: No validated customer interviews, conversion data or paid demand are currently published.

known_gaps: No public pricing or paid support SLA is established.
Benchmark results are not processor certification or guaranteed performance predictions.
The Windows desktop is distinct from the portable CLI/core support matrix.
